description: Three ARROW-valued handlers, each with an unhandled call to a `!` function in its body: an expression body `${(e) => risky()}`, a block body `${() => { @r = 1; risky() }}`, and the braced `{ () => risky() }`. E-ERROR-002 fires once per handler — three times. A plain function REFERENCE (`onclick=risky`) is not a call and is pinned clean in handler-failable-reference-and-guard-neg.
rationale: §19.4.3 (S440 ruling) — an arrow body runs on the event exactly like `{ risky() }`, so an unhandled `!` call in it is E-ERROR-002 exactly as in the braced forms.
